requirements.consumer_truth: HAC-19b rejects missing authority/impact/transaction; HAC-19c checks stale/rename/split/merge identity and rollback. They do not combine all six source edges into one pre-Canonical gate.

HAC-20b rejects missing obligation/negative/S4 edges and HAC-20c checks discovery-delta backflow. The adopted-pair comparison and a visible context-cost/drift-risk residual are integrated in this audit. Exhaustive whole-IR and consumer-condition closure is unproven; no sole residual or source closure is claimed.

Contract binds task/skill/model-catalog/allowlist to generated pack/minimal team/independent verify; negative case rejects self-promotion/unauthorized tool/self-verification; boundary case stales on catalog change and requires regenerate/retire. Adopted 072 covers candidate/shadow authority only; remaining legacy stale triggers and all named fail-closed branches are not closed by that pair.

Positive case uses blind bench plus real task for use-specific selection; negative case rejects averaging away severe failures/scope deviation; boundary case compares and reroutes model/effort on quality decline. Adopted LABO-064-002 pair exactly preserves NFR-35's blind/reproducibility/no-compensation conditions.

The same contract requires reproducible fixture/rubric/task/risk, blind score, effective cost, routing and exception receipt; negative case rejects smoke-only, serious-failure averaging, unit-price optimization, and unjustified effort defaults; boundary case re-routes on quality decline.

Contract requires sandbox/classification/opt-out; HAC-23b rejects allowlist escape, scope escape, confidential delegation, and persistent bypass; 23c fails closed on quota exhaustion or egress deviation. Adopted SECURITY-029-002 retains the third-party-runtime data/opt-out slice only.

HAC-23b rejects persistent bypass. Adopted SECURITY-032-001 proves repository permanent deny precedence over one-shot marker/provider flag; runtime-only activation and cleanup, plus YOLO limited to allowlist-less runtime transition, remain unclosed.

Contract says security sufficiency is judged only by local enforcement; adopted SECURITY-029-002 keeps vendor claims separate from locally verified egress/filesystem/scan evidence within its added third-party-runtime scope.

HAC-23c explicitly requires fail-closed retreat and quarantine for quota depletion/egress drift. Adopted OS general budget/stop records do not state planned quota/rate queue hold or alternate-runtime proposal and no-unplanned-retry behavior.

lane retreats fail-closed by either holding the queue or proposing routing to an alternative runtime

already_covered: HELIXOS-018/019 adopted source-management scope: assignment/attempt identity, budget/deadline/scope stop, cumulative constraints, handoff, evidence and unfinished obligations persist.
INTELLIGENCE-010 is a placement proposal, not rerouting or execution authority.
SECURITY-029 is added-runtime data/opt-out scope; its receipt does not cover quota/rate retreat.
requirements.true_unresolved_condition: Existing generic budget/stop/attempt records do not state runtime quota/rate exhaustion as a planned state, the source’s queue-hold-or-alternative-routing-proposal retreat, or reject an unplanned retry. HAC-23c adds a shared consumer-level quarantine oracle, but its exact allocation to NFR-40 versus the other HR-FR-HIL-23 atoms is not resolved; do not silently import it as a new NFR-40 condition.
requirements.draft_l2_material: For a selected runtime operation that returns quota exhaustion or a rate limit, preserve that condition as a planned non-success state and have the lane fail-close to one of the source’s alternatives: hold the queue or submit a proposal to route to an alternative runtime. A proposal is not an executed reroute; existing OS assignment/authority continues to decide execution. Do not continue as if capacity remained and do not retry without a plan. Reuse current stop, budget, attempt, handoff, and evidence conditions.
requirements.draft_l11_material: Normal fixture: selected worker runtime reports quota exhaustion/rate limit; lane records a planned non-success and either retains work in queue or emits an alternative-runtime routing proposal, with no execution/retry until existing assignment/authority permits it. Independent negatives: continue despite exhausted quota; retry without an existing plan; bypass state as transient generic error; treat proposal as approved/dispatch and execute alternative runtime automatically. Change fixture: after a later externally supplied available state, resume only under current OS assignment and cumulative constraints.

fixtures.normal_queue_hold: planned quota/rate state -> queue retained and work not started/continued
fixtures.normal_route_proposal: planned quota/rate state -> alternative runtime proposal returned; no automatic dispatch/adoption
fixtures.negative_unplanned_retry: retry occurs without a planned retry condition -> reject
fixtures.negative_ignored_exhaustion: work continues despite quota/rate exhaustion -> reject
fixtures.negative_auto_route: alternative proposal is treated as permission and dispatched automatically -> reject
fixtures.explicit_nonrequirements: no numeric quota threshold, retry count, reset time, delay, new approval, ticket, or fixed provider schema is inferred
